Pooja - Content: I'll draft the blog + socials. Tone: engineer-first. Two headline options; prefer concise.
Liam - Design: I can do hero + a simple benchmark graphic. Need final copy Thu AM.

Pooja - Content: Draft social (X): "RefApp Snack: a tiny OSS starter to build & tune LLM features locally + in the cloud. Webinar Nov 29. https://redwood.ai/refapp-snack"
Sam - GrowthOps: I'll set up the LP and zap to HubSpot. Will share test link shortly.
Mira - Growth: Owners: Ethan (tutorial + bench), Pooja (blog + socials), Liam (assets), Sam (webinar + routing). Target publish + webinar Nov 29 AM. Closing 680
